d: A political earthquake in America. Democrats have swept both chambers of Congress, handing Donald Trump a major setback and gaining the power to challenge his agenda for the next two years. But what does this mandate mean for the economy, the Iran war and the growing influence of Big Tech? From rising prices and AI regulation to Elon Musk's political spending, our New York correspondent Pavni Mittal examines the issues behind the Democratic victory and the challenges that lie ahead for both parties. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
